note: Village of Cedar Rapids riverside park on the Cedar River at the north edge of town (Hwy 52); tables, fire pits, canoe landing, playground. The sites line a grass lane between the highway and the riverbank trees. Pay at a drop box (old reports: $10-15 a night). --Claude
summary: Village page unread (Cloudflare); the county development agency page (2025) confirms tent sites plus 10 electric RV sites, city water and restrooms. No dated rate. Waterfront down, riverfront -> riverview: the sites are on a grass lane ~35-45 m from the river behind a near-continuous belt of bank trees. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWN, riverfront -> riverview (lead; apply.py doesn't write waterfront). The stored riverfront was never audited (commit-level only, 9af42bc). On Esri (320 m frame, leaf-off) and NAIP (280 m frame) the park is a strip ~50-70 m wide between Hwy 52 and the Cedar River. Campers park on a grass lane down its middle (a rig is visible at ~41.5636,-98.1470). Between the lane and the water, ~35-45 m away, is a belt of bank trees that runs almost unbroken from ~41.5645 to ~41.5632. Only the open north end (~41.5648) reaches the water. The channel is ~40-60 m wide, so it is a river, not a creek, but a continuous treeline is a buffer, so riverfront isn't earned. The water should still be visible through bare trees, so riverview. Unsure; the downgrade follows the rule.
